beats.say: Rudi thinks they do. So he buys the *stinkiest* cheese in town.
He loads a trap with *cheese.* The mouse walks right past it... to the *cookies.*
The trap failed, so Rudi gets a cheese the size of a *sofa.* The mouse? Busy with the *cereal.*
In the wild, mice mostly eat *grains*, seeds and fruit.
A Manchester researcher found strong cheese can actually put mice *off.*
The pest experts' number one bait? *Peanut butter.* Sweet, fatty and smelly.
So the sofa-sized cheese? A very expensive *mistake.*
Use a pea-sized dab of *peanut butter*, and seal gaps as wide as a *pencil.*
And keep cereal and cookies in *sealed* tins.
So before Rudi buys more cheese... remember:
